VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims all 72 tests pass and provides a plausible technical explanation, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires "all 72 tests pass," which demands verifiable proof, not assertion. Self-reports are the weakest evidence class and cannot establish objective test passage without supporting artifacts.
